integrity.proof_basis: Uniform Taylor expansion of the ellipse perimeter integral and exact l-infinity operator norm of the pair-sum map.

scientific_limitations: Local statement only for centered ellipsoids whose semiaxes approach 1.
Uses the three coordinate-plane section geodesics; no claim is made for arbitrary convex surfaces or the full geodesic spectrum.
The primary stability paper was available only as an abstract and bibliographic record in this run; residual overlap risk remains.
title: Sharp local geodesic-length conditioning for ellipsoids near the round sphere
